# CANDIDATE: VOLUME_PROFILE_HVN_REVERSION_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-09-10  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price extends beyond 1.5×ATR(14) above the intraday high-volume node (HVN) with bearish ribbon (EMA9 < EMA21) and elevated RSI (>60), a short mean-reversion edge exists. The HVN represents institutional acceptance; extended deviations signal exhaustion. This captures short-term reversion to value areas missed by VWAP-based systems.

## Mechanism

1. **Intraday volume profile**: Calculate cumulative volume per 0.50 SPY width bin using 5-min bars from 09:30 ET to current bar. Identify HVN (price bin with max volume).
2. **Entry trigger**: When close > (HVN + 1.5×ATR(14)), RSI(14) > 60, and EMA9(5min) < EMA21(5min) (bearish ribbon), enter short at bar close.
3. **Exit**: 
   - Initial stop: prior swing high (or ORH if higher) 
   - TP1: 1.0R (risk = entry - stop)
   - Runner: trail stop using Chandelier exit (ATR(14)×3)
   - Time filter: only active 10:00-12:00 EST, VIX > 20, ribbon width > 0.05% of price
